## Updates:
- Main#0e1b12d: Integrated JSound into LWJGL (by @ShirosakiMio)

## Changes:
- GP#1797: Limit joystick size to allowed property bounds when resizing with drag handle (by @youfeng11)
- GP#1799: Increased polling rate for joystick in controller mapping mode, and normalized offset by actual interval (by @MovTery)

## Fixes:
- GP#1789: CurseForge downloads failing (by @MovTery)
- GP#1793: Window size oscillation causing severe flickering in picture-in-picture/split-screen mode (by @MovTery)
- GP#1793: Control layout not functioning properly when window size changes (by @MovTery)
- GP#1794: Keep-alive foreground service startup timeout causing game process crash (by @MovTery)
- GP#1795: Clicking a hotbar slot triggers the switch key twice in succession (by @MovTery)
- GP#1798: ENOENT error when saving control layout due to external storage issues (by @MovTery)

bodies.markdown:
## 更新：
- Main#0e1b12d：集成 JSound 到 LWJGL (by @ShirosakiMio)


## 调整：
- GP#1797：使用拖动手柄调整摇杆大小时，限制为属性允许的大小 (by @youfeng11)
- GP#1799：提升手柄映射模式摇杆的轮询采样率，并按实际间隔归一化偏移量 (by @MovTery)


## 修复：
- GP#1789：CurseForge 无法正常下载文件 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1793：小窗/分屏模式下窗口尺寸反复震荡导致游戏剧烈闪屏 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1793：窗口尺寸变更时，控制布局无法正常使用 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1794：保活前台服务启动超时导致游戏进程崩溃 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1795：单击快捷栏槽位连续触发两次切换按键 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1798：外部存储异常时保存控件布局报 ENOENT (by @MovTery)
